_readme: Owner-edited: paste an affiliate URL (https only) as the value for an item id from src/lib/shop.js. An empty value means the plain brand link is shown with no affiliate label. Optional price: use { "url": "https://...", "price": "From $89" } instead of a plain string; the price is shown only when present, copied from the brand's own site (never invented). Affiliate tags are public by design; never put a secret here. See docs/AFFILIATES.md.
